row.evidence: Meltwater's pricing is quote-only (Starter, Pro, Enterprise and Agency all "Contact Sales"), and its SSO guide says SAML SSO "is available based on your Meltwater subscription" and is added to the contract through Support; no SCIM or automated provisioning is documented in the help community, developer portal or pricing page.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: all four tiers (Starter, Pro, Enterprise, Agency) are Contact Sales, priced by modules, sources, users and integrations. SAML 2.0 SSO exists but is sold per contract ('request to add SSO to your existing contract'); the plan it belongs to is not public, so sso_plan is null. Set-up is done by Meltwater Support (domain verification by DNS TXT record, SP metadata exchange). No SCIM, JIT or IdP provisioning is described; users are created in Account > Manage Users. The developer portal covers listening, analytics, Explore+, AI visibility and content-import data APIs only, with no user endpoints; 'API & MCP Integrations' is listed for Enterprise and Agency. Not found in Okta's OIN; no Entra tutorial. 'None' is by absence (rule 5); the detailed 'Manage Users' help article is login-gated.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Key features include 'API & MCP Integrations' and 'Governance, workflows & permissions'.

scim.notes: Neither the SSO setup guide nor the 1,602-topic community/knowledge-base sitemap nor the 171-page developer portal mentions SCIM or provisioning. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: developer.meltwater.com documents data APIs (Listening, Mira, Social Analytics, Explore+, AI Visibility, Bring Your Own Content, Influencer Campaigns) and an MCP server; its sitemap has no user, member or admin endpoints.

fallbacks.notes: Manual user creation in Account > Manage Users. SAML SSO identifies users by email on verified domains (c14); whether SSO creates accounts on first login is not stated.
